blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The death of her husband, 1st Lt. Angeleo Adrian Peñaflor, in a midair collision involving two Philippine Air Force (PAF) trainer aircraft has left Bernadette feeling as though she has lost a part of her soul. “When you take away my greatest love, you might as well take my soul with you,” Bernadette wrote in a social media post on Saturday. “They say it’s all part and parcel of the job. But no one ever prepares you for the pain of losing the person who means the world to you,” she added. READ: 4 PAF pilots […]...
